learned_patterns.pattern: The Signal Engine has produced NO fresh matrix since 2026-06-30 — roughly 21 days. SAFE MODE has therefore been continuous, and no signal-conditioned trade has ever been graded. A manually-fired (workflow_dispatch) engine with no reliable trigger degenerates to permanently-stale data; the §2.5 guard correctly blocks entries but the whole quant loop is idle until the workflow is fixed or fired. This is the top-priority operational failure.

The manual fractional stop worked as designed: INTC breached its stop and an agentic session exited it 07-07 at -14.98% (near, slightly past, the 12.6% ATR stop — consistent with a gap/next-check fill rather than a live broker stop). Capping the loss on a single high-ATR name (INTC ATR was 7.6%, BBW 40%) is exactly the LAB sleeve's purpose. High-beta single names can round-trip +8% -> -15% inside a week; the stop is what keeps that from compounding.

For the second time, an agentic fill (this time the INTC stop-sell) executed with no session writing it to memory — surfaced only by the §3 broker+orders reconciliation. Broker state is the source of truth (§5.1); always reconcile positions AND recent orders, and fold in agentic fills. Prose memory routinely lags the broker across multi-session gaps.

Losing INTC pulled LAB from 25.9% to 17.9% — now UNDER its 20% Accumulation cap. Stop-outs are the organic mechanism that brings an over-cap LAB sleeve back into band without force-selling (§17.3). The book now sits at a near-target 18/50/24 LAB/CORE/DRIP with ~8% cash awaiting the next deposit-route to DRIP.

06-30 composites read NEUTRAL/BEARISH across the board while the tape has since rallied hard (semis, QQQ, ARKK all up multi-percent today). On stale data this divergence is uninterpretable — but it reinforces that a lagging MACD-driven composite should never be trusted as a leading signal, and that stale composites must be labeled, not displayed as live.

Dividend yields render sanely (JEPQ 9.95%, JEPI 8.10%, SCHD 3.30%) but dividend_growth_streak=0 and payout_ratio=null persist for every DRIP name, so the §15.3 screen (streak>=5, payout<80%) stays unverifiable. Covered-call names (JEPI/JEPQ, payout N/A by rule) can seed on yield; dividend-growth names wait on the streak/payout fix.
